provenance.incarnation: Naomi Hunter original MGS4,2014; compact nape bun/two front strands, charcoal belted knee coatdress/scarf, continuous dark full wrist sleeves and black gloves with buckles, bare lower legs/low black shoes, coat belt-tail/pocket flap detail. No invented bag, no MGS1 coat/badge. Newly drawn Rétro CQC movement adaptation.
